_comment: Registry for the US-remote search lane (see DESIGN-remote.md). Same entry shape as companies.json. These are remote-friendly employers on tier-1 ATSes; each was VERIFIED to return live US-remote roles before adding (do not guess slugs). The remote lane reads THIS file (not companies.json), applies a US-remote gate instead of the local gate, and runs each profile with remote_search:true. Grow this list over time; the daily job never fetches logos (fetch_logos.py reads this file too).
